integrationNotes: Affiliate Marketing is the highest-leverage ₦0 starting hustle for most Nigerians in 2026. Primary platforms: StakeCut (best beginner naira, free join, weekly bank transfer), Selar (creator marketplace, 20–50%), Expertnaire (higher commissions up to 75%, better for those with audience). Secondary: Jumia/Konga for physical, Systeme.io/ClickBank for dollar recurring. Promotion channels that work without a website: WhatsApp Status + broadcast, TikTok, Facebook groups, Instagram. Always verify current payout rules and product quality before promoting. Official StakeCut channel ID confirmed.
